class.name: RealityPortalCamera3D
class.brief_description: Makes its Window open as a RealityKit portal window on visionOS.
class.description: In the [b]2D Window[/b] presentation style, a [Window] holding this camera opens as a portal window: a window looking into the [Window]'s own 3D world from this camera, as the [b]Portal Window[/b] presentation style does for the main scene. Enable [member Viewport.own_world_3d] on the [Window], and place it with [member Window.placement].

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the portal's content is clipped by a plane at [member clipping_plane_position] facing [member clipping_plane_normal], as with [member RealityPortalMeshInstance3D.clipping_plane_enabled].
Normal of the clipping plane, in the portal window's space: [code]+Z[/code] points toward the person.
Position of the clipping plane, in meters from the center of the portal window.

If [code]true[/code], objects with a [RealityPortalCrossing3D] can cross a plane at [member crossing_plane_position] facing [member crossing_plane_normal] and appear outside the portal window, as with [member RealityPortalMeshInstance3D.crossing_plane_enabled]. Objects behind this camera appear in front of the window.
Normal of the crossing plane, in the portal window's space: [code]+Z[/code] points toward the person.
Position of the crossing plane, in meters from the center of the portal window.
Meters of the portal per world unit. If [code]0[/code], the portal window shows a slider to choose the scale.
